clue.text: The housekeeper's pantry is not yet full

definitions.meaning: the store room of a large house, run by the housekeeper, for preserves and drinks
a space not yet full still has some space left in it

explanation.surface: A remark that the housekeeper's larder has space left over.
explanation.definitionFit: A still-room is a household storeroom for preserves and cordials; and a container with space left is said to have it still.

clue.text: The many-not us!

definitions.meaning: the masses, other people as a crowd
the pronoun for the other side, as opposed to ourselves

explanation.surface: A cry setting the masses apart from our own small group.
explanation.walkthrough: The first two words also run together to show the answer's letters, a bonus hint.
explanation.definitionFit: The third-person plural pronoun names other people, the crowd set against the speakers.

clue.text: Notable who came from a log cabin to an English city

definitions.text: Notable who came from a log cabin
definitions.meaning: Abraham ..., US president, famously born in a Kentucky log cabin
the cathedral city and county town of Lincolnshire

explanation.surface: A famous figure's rise from humble backwoods beginnings to an English city.
explanation.definitionFit: The US president was born in a log cabin; the same name belongs to the cathedral city in eastern England.

clue.text: Relaxation I have when unrelaxed

explanation.surface: A paradox: someone who rests yet remains on edge.
explanation.definitionFit: Restive means fidgety and uneasy, the opposite of calm.

clue.text: Is it the cry of a cryer? Most certainly!

definitions.text: Is it the cry of a cryer?
definitions.meaning: the call 'hear ye' given by a town crier or court official, also spelt oyez
an emphatic 'oh, yes!'

explanation.surface: A question about a town crier's call, answered emphatically.
explanation.definitionFit: The crier's call for silence is spelt oyes or oyez; split as two words it is an emphatic agreement.

clue.text: A sign that one does not need spectacles for toasting

definitions.text: A sign that one does not need spectacles for toasting

parts.words: A sign that one does not need spectacles for toasting
parts.note: eyewear pushed up on the forehead shows it is not needed; tumblers lifted are a toast

explanation.surface: An observation about someone pushing their specs up their nose, or not needing them at a toast.
explanation.definitionFit: Spectacles pushed up out of the way are not being used, while lifted drinking vessels are the gesture of a toast.

clue.text: The bowling analysis is somewhat exaggerated

definitions.text: The bowling analysis is somewhat exaggerated

parts.words: The bowling analysis is somewhat exaggerated
parts.note: in cricket a bowler's figures are counted in overs, so a statement of overs bowled; also a claim that goes too far

explanation.surface: A complaint that a cricketer's bowling figures have been inflated.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket, an over is a set of six balls bowled, and a bowler's analysis lists overs, runs and wickets.
explanation.definitionFit: Read in two halves it is a cricket statement of overs; as one word it is an exaggerated claim, a hyperbole.

clue.text: Say goodbye when you go on holiday from work

definitions.meaning: to bid farewell and depart
leave is time off work, so to use one's holiday allowance

explanation.surface: A colleague bidding farewell before heading off on vacation.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means to depart formally; read literally, it means using one's allotted time off.

clue.text: A rough count suggests the Shadow Education Secretary has won

parts.note: Jack Straw, Labour's shadow education spokesman when this puzzle appeared
to poll is to win a number of votes

explanation.surface: A newspaper report that an informal survey favours the opposition's education spokesman.
explanation.walkthrough: Jack Straw was Labour's Shadow Education Secretary from 1987 to 1992; the clue is of its time.
explanation.definitionFit: An unofficial sounding of opinion gives only an approximate tally of views.

clue.text: Cinema hoarding left to Jack

annotationWithheld.why: Clue as held reads 'Cinema hoarding left to Jack (9)', but the answer's nautical sense is the right-hand side for a sailor, not left; likely a misprint of 'right' and no scan to confirm.

clue.text: To silence an expression of disbelief

parts.note: sh is the call for silence

explanation.surface: Telling someone to be quiet about a scoffing remark.
explanation.definitionFit: Tosh is a dismissive word meaning nonsense, uttered when one does not believe something.

clue.text: Oil dispensed in cubic centimetres for an abdominal complaint

indicators.note: the shuffled oil sits between the two letters for the measure

parts.note: cc is the abbreviation for cubic centimetres

indicators.note: medicine dispensed is made up, so the letters of oil are made up anew

explanation.surface: A pharmacist doling out oil in measured doses for a stomach ache.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dispensed' looks like the pharmacist's verb but signals the anagram; the solver needs CC for cubic centimetres as the outer piece.
explanation.definitionFit: Colic is severe pain in the abdomen, common in babies and horses.

clue.text: Father needs it for making glass or porcelain

parts.note: Fr is the abbreviation for Father, a priest

explanation.surface: A priest requires something to make glassware or china.
explanation.definitionFit: Frit is the fused mixture of sand and fluxes used as a raw material by glassmakers and potters.

clue.text: Former religious leader

definitions.meaning: earlier or previous
the head of a priory, below an abbot

explanation.surface: Describing an ex-head of a church community.
explanation.definitionFit: Prior means earlier; it is also the title of the monk heading a priory.

clue.text: Bet he isn't a salaried employee

definitions.meaning: a stake or gamble
one paid wages, by the hour or week, rather than an annual salary

explanation.surface: A gamble on someone's employment status.
explanation.definitionFit: A wager is a bet; humorously, a wager is one who earns wages rather than a salary.

clue.text: What Bismarck recommended as well as blood when under fire?

definitions.text: What Bismarck recommended as well as blood
definitions.meaning: the Prussian chancellor's 'blood ...' speech; the missing part follows blood
a firedog, the metal support placed in a hearth under burning logs

explanation.surface: A historical question about the Iron Chancellor's policy in wartime.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase completes Bismarck's 'blood and iron'; as one word it is the metal stand for logs in a fireplace.

clue.text: He no longer appears an extortionist

definitions.meaning: a performer who has left the stage, a former player
one who demands money unfairly or by force

explanation.surface: A former stage performer revealed as a blackmailer.
explanation.definitionFit: Split, it is a retired performer; as one word, one who exacts payment by pressure.

clue.text: Magazine supplement advising motorist how to overtake

definitions.meaning: a detachable section of a magazine
the instruction to swing out from behind the car in front

explanation.surface: A motoring magazine insert with tips on passing other cars.
explanation.definitionFit: A removable section of a publication; also the move a driver makes into the outer lane to pass.

clue.text: Kind group of people prepared to print

parts.note: a kind or sort is a type
a set is a circle or clique

explanation.surface: Like-minded people getting ready to publish.
explanation.definitionFit: Copy that is typeset has been arranged in type ready for the press.

clue.text: As Metro is reorganised he becomes a conductor

indicators.note: the letters are reorganised into a new order

explanation.surface: An underground railway restructuring puts someone new in charge.
explanation.definitionFit: A maestro is a distinguished leader of an orchestra.

clue.text: Bad French air causes fever

parts.note: an aria is an air or tune

explanation.surface: Unhealthy air in France brings on illness.
explanation.walkthrough: The disease was once blamed on 'bad air' from swamps, so the surface is also its etymology.
explanation.definitionFit: Malaria is a mosquito-borne disease marked by recurring bouts of high fever.

clue.text: Roll-apparently to one side rather than back and forth

definitions.meaning: a ... or register of names

definitions.text: to one side rather than back and forth
definitions.meaning: a ship's lean to one side, as opposed to rocking

explanation.surface: A nautical distinction between a ship's lean and its rocking.
explanation.definitionFit: A roll is a register of names, and a ship that leans steadily to one side is said to do so.

clue.text: Tell-tale evidence that a boy has been robbing the orchard

definitions.text: Tell-tale evidence that a boy has been robbing the orchard

parts.words: Tell-tale evidence that a boy has been robbing the orchard
parts.note: the stolen fruit found on a scrumping lad

explanation.surface: A boy caught out after scrumping fruit from someone's trees.
explanation.definitionFit: The fruit most often picked from orchard trees is what the thief would be caught holding.

clue.text: Middle East backing one ruler or another

indicators.note: turned to face backwards, so the letters run in reverse

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
R stands for rex or regina, king or queen

explanation.surface: A Middle Eastern state supporting one monarch or the other.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backing' turns ME to EM; 'another' refers back to 'ruler' and defines a different kind of sovereign.
explanation.definitionFit: An emir is a Muslim prince or commander, a sovereign of another sort.

clue.text: House doctor who becomes a primate

explanation.surface: A house doctor who turns into an ape.
explanation.definitionFit: Homo is the genus of primates that includes humans.

clue.text: Don't make the alteration in haste then

indicators.note: the answer lies inside the run of letters of the next words

explanation.surface: An editor's warning against changing text too hastily.
explanation.definitionFit: Stet is the proofreader's mark meaning let it stand, cancelling a correction.

clue.text: Showing how protesters may make their point

definitions.meaning: displaying or exhibiting

definitions.text: how protesters may make their point
definitions.meaning: marching and rallying in public protest

explanation.surface: How marchers get their message across.
explanation.definitionFit: Exhibiting something; also taking part in a public protest march.

clue.text: The alacrity an impatient correspondent depends upon

definitions.meaning: great speed or promptness
a letter writer in a hurry relies on quick mail delivery

explanation.surface: An eager letter writer relying on speedy mail.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means with all speed; split, it is the speed of the mail on which a letter writer depends.
